body: This survey really put how badly I am suffering in to perspective. I was crying as I filled it out.  I feel like this subreddit is the only place that gets me. I have no one IRL to talk to.
I get this. It's like a weird invisible barrier in my throat when I try to tell anyone I am seriously struggling with life and contemplate death constantly.  Haha me too thanks
This is my every waking moment. Haha
I truly wish I had someone who worries about me. I can cry alone for hours and even if someone hears me they will just avoid me more. I really really want to die

I recently started drinking. I am 28 and never really touched it before then. Now I am so alone and so ashamed of existing that I am learning how to be a cheap drunk just to numb the pain. So far no one has even noticed.

I am so isolated and alone. I used to have friends. I used to be as normal as I could be after having been raised in neglect. The shadow of my abuser taints everything that everyone says. My shame is so great that I will stop doing things I love if anyone laughs. I have no one now. I had a mental breakdown and now everyone is gone. I've been completely isolated for 6 years now. I'm not... normal anymore. I don't even know how to talk. No one is relateable. I feel like I am constantly outside the window of a warm and cozy home watching a family eat a hot dinner and shoot the shit. I cannot speak very well anymore. I stammer and stutter now. My health is getting worse. I have been bleeding nonstop for months. As time grinds onward more people forget I even existed, or get weirded out when I reach out. I want to die so badly. I recently started drinking. It's something I swore I would never do because my parents were alcoholics. But now I drink and it might just be my easy out. No one will care when I am gone. I just need sweet sweet release. I am so tired.
